description: Minimal shared types for public content difficulty labels. Full E_diff module scores and contentRating records are private (spec-server cache only). See docs/lexicon-public-private-audit.md.

domainId.description: Optional canonical domain-taxonomy id (e.g. domain:news, domain:news:sports, domain:webtoon:romance). Additive alongside sourceDomain -- lets a domain node recursively belong to a broader parent domain per B9 Continuous Acquisition Spectrum Model S4.3's domain-hierarchy note. Absent means the flat sourceDomain bucket is the only signal available. Taxonomy structure only -- never a computed aggregate score or axis value. See spec-research-suite/docs/lexicons/proposals/reference/017_continuous_acquisition_spectrum_hydration.md.

parentDomainId.description: Immediate parent domainId in the taxonomy, or absent for a top-level domain. Enables recursive domain rollups without requiring a flat domain list. Describes taxonomy structure only -- it is never a computed aggregate score or axis value.

zone.description: Difficulty zone band for catalog display.

specVersion.description: Algorithm version label only — not fitted weights.
